briefing.ja: 市立図書館の閲覧室から、館外持ち出し禁止の大型写真集が16時から16時30分の間に持ち去られた。その時間に館内にいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: A large photo book that is not allowed to leave the library was taken from the reading room between 16:00 and 16:30. One of the six people in the library is the thief, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

characters.name: Yuna (high school student at a study desk)

text.2: I was shelving books in the reading room from 16:10 to 16:20.
text.3: I was putting books back on the shelves from ten past four until twenty past.
text.4: I was up and down the reading room with the book trolley from ten past to twenty past.
text.5: I am not sure I would have noticed everything, but I was shelving books in the reading room from ten past four until twenty past.

facts.hintJa: shelve = 棚に戻す / trolley = 配架用の台車 / put back = 戻す

text.2: The returns box was not opened before 16:25.
text.3: Nobody had opened the returns box before twenty-five past four.
text.4: As far as I know, nobody had been near the returns box by then.
text.5: I cannot speak for the whole afternoon, but I do not think the returns box was opened before twenty-five past four.

facts.hintJa: returns box = 返却ポスト / open = 開ける / nobody = 誰も〜ない

text.1: Study desk. I saw the room. Until 16:20.
text.2: From my study desk I could see the reading room until 16:20.
text.3: I sat at a study desk and could see the reading room until twenty past.
text.4: From where I sat, most of the reading room was in front of me until twenty past.
text.5: I was working on my homework, but from my study desk I could see most of the reading room until twenty past four.

facts.hintJa: study desk = 自習席 / see = 見える / most of = 〜の大半

text.1: My bag. Across both desks. Untouched. Until 16:20.
text.2: My bag and books lay untouched across the study desks until 16:20.
text.3: My things were spread over both study desks until twenty past four, and nobody had moved them.
text.4: Anyone sitting down there would have had to move my bag first.
text.5: I am not the tidiest, but my bag and books lay across both study desks until twenty past four, and nothing had been moved.

facts.hintJa: bag = かばん / spread = 広げる / move = どかす

text.1: Photo book. On the table. At 16:10.
text.2: The photo book was still on the table at 16:10.
text.3: I am sure the big photo book was on that table at ten past four.
text.4: The photo book was certainly still lying there when I looked up at ten past.
text.5: I may be a few minutes out, but the photo book was still on the table at around ten past four.

facts.hintJa: photo book = 写真集 / still = まだ / table = 机

text.2: The photo book was gone from the table at 16:20.
text.3: When I looked again at twenty past four, the book was not there.
text.4: By twenty past, the space where the book had been was empty.
text.5: I did not see anyone take it, but the photo book had gone from the table by twenty past four.

facts.hintJa: gone = なくなっている / look again = もう一度見る / empty = 何も無い

text.2: I worked at the stack door from 16:05 to 16:20.
text.3: I was mending the lock on the stack door from five past until twenty past.
text.4: I had my tools out at that door for a good quarter of an hour.
text.5: I did not watch the clock closely, but I was working on the stack door lock from five past until twenty past four.

facts.hintJa: stack door = 書庫の扉 / mend = 直す / tools = 工具

text.2: The stack door was locked until 16:20.
text.3: The door to the stacks stayed locked until twenty past four.
text.4: If somebody told you they had been in the stacks before twenty past, that door says otherwise.
text.5: I cannot be completely certain to the minute, but the stack door stayed locked until at least twenty past four.

facts.hintJa: locked = 鍵がかかっている / stay = 〜のままである / say otherwise = 違うと示す

text.2: I was alone at the counter from 16:05 to 16:20.
text.3: Nobody stood at the counter with me between five past and twenty past.
text.4: If somebody had come behind the counter, I would have had to make room.
text.5: I would hesitate to call it a quiet afternoon, but I was alone at the counter from five past until twenty past four.

facts.hintJa: counter = カウンター / alone = 一人で / make room = 場所を空ける

text.2: No book was checked out between 16:00 and 16:30.
text.3: Nobody borrowed a book between four o'clock and half past four.
text.4: Had anyone borrowed a book in that half hour, the loan record would show it.
text.5: I would rather you looked at the record yourself, but it shows no book borrowed between four o'clock and half past.

facts.hintJa: check out = 貸出手続きをする / loan record = 貸出記録 / borrow = 借りる

text.2: My cleaning cart blocked the entrance from 16:10 to 16:15.
text.3: My cart stood across the entrance from ten past until a quarter past.
text.4: Nobody could have squeezed past my cart in that doorway for those five minutes.
text.5: I was not counting the minutes, but my cleaning cart stood across the entrance from ten past until a quarter past four.

facts.hintJa: cart = 清掃用のカート / block = ふさぐ / entrance = 入口

text.2: The corridor floor was wet until 16:25.
text.3: I had just mopped the corridor, and it stayed wet until twenty-five past.
text.4: Anyone walking down there would have left prints all over my clean floor.
text.5: It dries slowly at this time of year, so the corridor floor stayed wet until about twenty-five past four.

facts.hintJa: corridor = 廊下 / mop = 床を拭く / dry = 乾く

text.2: I was in the stack room at 16:15.
text.3: I went into the stacks at about a quarter past four.
text.4: I had gone through to the stacks by then, so I saw nothing of the room.
text.5: I am hopeless with times, but I had gone into the stack room by about a quarter past four.

lie.hintJa: stack room = 書庫 / go into = 中へ入る / hopeless = 苦手である

contradictions.meaningJa: Soraは16:15に書庫にいたと言うが、Takuは書庫の扉が16:20まで施錠されていたと言っている。Kenjiの16:10の証言で持ち去られた時間帯が絞られ、Yunaの視界とHanaのカウンターとEmiのカートで、その間に閲覧室を離れられた者がいないことが分かる。

text.1: Me. Outside. Through the entrance. From 16:10.
text.2: I went out through the entrance at 16:10.
text.3: I stepped out through the entrance at about ten past four.
text.4: I had gone outside for a while by then, so I saw none of it.
text.5: I did not look at the clock on the way out, but I was outside through the entrance by about ten past four.

lie.hintJa: go out = 外へ出る / entrance = 入口 / for a while = しばらくの間

contradictions.meaningJa: Yunaは16:10に入口から外へ出たと言うが、Emiの清掃カートが16:10から16:15まで入口を塞いでいた。SoraとKenjiとTakuとHanaの証言で、その時間帯に館内から出る他の経路も使えなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was at the study desks at 16:15.
text.3: I moved over to the study desks at about a quarter past four.
text.4: I had taken my things over to the desks by then, so I was not at that table.
text.5: I move about a lot when I read, but I had taken my things over to the study desks by around a quarter past four.

lie.hintJa: study desks = 自習席 / move over = 移動する / things = 持ち物

contradictions.meaningJa: Kenjiは16:15に自習席へ移ったと言うが、Yunaのかばんと本が16:20まで自習席に広げたままで、どかされた跡もない。Soraの配架とTakuの書庫の扉とHanaのカウンターとEmiのカートで、その時間帯に閲覧室から抜けられなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was at the counter at 16:15.
text.3: I was at the counter getting my job sheet signed at a quarter past.
text.4: I was over at the counter with the paperwork, so I was nowhere near the shelves.
text.5: You could ask at the counter, but I believe I was over there getting my job sheet signed at around a quarter past four.

lie.hintJa: job sheet = 作業伝票 / sign = 署名する / paperwork = 書類仕事

contradictions.meaningJa: Takuは16:15にカウンターにいたと言うが、Hanaは16:05から16:20まで一人でカウンターに立っていたと言っている。Kenjiが16:20に写真集が無くなっていたと言い、SoraとYunaとEmiの証言で、その直前の閲覧室と入口の様子が分かる。

text.2: I was emptying the returns box at 16:15.
text.3: I went out to empty the returns box at about a quarter past four.
text.4: I had stepped out to see to the returns, so I was not at my desk.
text.5: That is my job every afternoon, and I believe I was emptying the returns box at around a quarter past four.

lie.hintJa: empty = 中身を取り出す / returns box = 返却ポスト / see to = 対応する

contradictions.meaningJa: Hanaは16:15に返却ポストの中身を取り出したと言うが、Soraは返却ポストが16:25まで開けられていないと言っている。Emiが拭いたばかりの廊下の床が濡れたままだったこと、Yunaの視界、Kenjiの16:10の証言、Takuの書庫の扉の作業で、その時間帯に館外へ出た者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was checking out a book at 16:15.
text.3: I was borrowing a book at the counter at about a quarter past four.
text.4: I had gone to the counter to take a book home, so I was not cleaning.
text.5: It is not something I do often, but I was borrowing a book at the counter at around a quarter past four.

lie.hintJa: borrow = 借りる / check out = 貸出手続きをする / counter = カウンター

contradictions.meaningJa: Emiは16:15にカウンターで本を借りていたと言うが、Hanaの貸出記録には16:00から16:30の間の貸出が1件もない。Kenjiの16:10の証言、Soraの配架、Yunaの視界、Takuの書庫の扉の作業で、その時間帯の館内の様子が分かる。

timelineEn: 16:05 The photo book was open on a table in the reading room.
16:10 The photo book was still on the table.
16:15 The photo book was taken from the reading room.
16:20 The table was empty and the book was gone.
16:25 The staff searched the reading room and the stacks.

keyExpressions.ja: もう一度言ってもらえますか。

keyExpressions.en: Which desk were you sitting at?
keyExpressions.ja: どの席に座っていましたか。

keyExpressions.en: As far as I can remember, ...
That does not fit with what she said.
keyExpressions.ja: それは彼女の話と合いません。
